evidence_policy.observed_runtime: A command was executed by the runner in an isolated temp HOME/tmux context.
evidence_policy.observed_static: The runner inspected source files from the pinned version and recorded exact source_evidence entries with relative file, line, pattern, and excerpt.
evidence_policy.recorded_historical: A prior local compatibility record or human-observed run note is recorded, but the runner did not freshly execute the runtime scenario.
evidence_policy.documented_claim: The pinned README/docs claim support but the runner did not execute the scenario.
evidence_policy.unknown: The runner could not verify the criterion from the pinned source and did not execute a runtime check.
evidence_policy.blocked: The scenario requires credentials, a real provider session, or mutation of user-global state and was not executed.
